verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's Dashboard docs explicitly claim org-wide visibility into review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns, and ROI metrics, with a companion page defining metrics — directly matching the engineering-lead dashboard story. However, evidence doesn't specifically confirm 'acceptance rates' or 'review coverage' as named metrics, nor is there independent/hands-on corroboration of the dashboard's actual usefulness at org scale. missing for 10: explicit mention of acceptance-rate tracking, review-coverage metrics, and third-party validation of dashboard quality.
